test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement is followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is true based on the given statement.

Statement:

H > L ≥ M ≥ N > O ≤ P ≤ Q

Conclusions:

I. L > P

II. M ≤ Q

options.text: Both conclusions I and II are true
Neither conclusion I nor II is true

solution:
**__Given statement__: **

H > L ≥ M ≥ N > O ≤ P ≤ Q

__Conclusions__:

I. L > P → False (We have L > O & O ≤ P, we get L > O ≤ P, so **L > P cannot be true.)**

II. M ≤ Q → False (We have M > O & O ≤ Q, we get M > O ≤ Q, so **M ≤ Q cannot be true.)**

So **neither conclusion I nor II is true.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 2)**
